dct_creator_sm: Neil Nevitte (University of Toronto, University of Calgary).
dct_description_sm: The 2000 Canadian Election Survey (CES) included three survey components. The Campaign-Period Survey (CPS) was completed in the 34 days between the election call, on Octeober 22, and the last day of the campaign, November 26. The Post-Election Survey (PES) was completed with respondents to the CPS in the fifteen weeks after the November 27 election, concluding about a week sround Christmas. The Mailback Survey (MBS) was completed with respondents to the PES normally one to weeks after completing the PES.
